name: NGC 6822 SC7 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6822 SC7, a globular cluster of the dwarf irregular galaxy NGC 6822, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6822sc7-hubble
story: SC7 is a compact globular cluster among the innermost of NGC 6822, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy. Studies of it find evidence that the cluster is being tidally distorted.

claims.text: NGC6822-SC7 is a globular cluster target of Hubble program 15336
NGC 6822 is an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy
NGC 6822 is a Local Group dwarf irregular galaxy
SC7 is a compact globular cluster
SC7 is one of the innermost globular clusters of NGC 6822
There is compelling evidence that SC7 is tidally distorted
